text: The NEWT Token Airdrop is Approaching Skip to Content Home X Home X Sign in Home X The NEWT Token Airdrop is Approaching Token — June 23, 2025 On this page Unlock full content The NEWT Token Generation Event (TGE) and airdrop claim will go live on June 24, 2025. The token will be live on Ethereum mainnet. What is Newton Protocol? Newton Protocol is a decentralized infrastructure layer for verifiable onchain automation and secure agent authorization. Built by Magic Newton Foundation with key contributions from Magic Labs, it uses trusted execution environments (TEEs) and zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs) to enable automated onchain finance that you can trust. Learn more about the agentic future in our litepaper . Newton Protocol is designed with verifiability, transparency, and security at its core. The NEWT token serves as the backbone of this design by powering staking, permissions, and incentives that protect users and discourage malicious behavior. Because agent-based automation involves sensitive actions like moving assets, we’ve prioritized security at the base layer. NEWT is deployed as an ERC-20 on Ethereum Mainnet, where the protocol’s staking contracts also reside. Magic Newton Foundation is proud to set a new standard for transparency with NEWT. From validator economics to governance and distribution, every aspect of NEWT is disclosed and verifiable. Explore the full tokenomics and disclosures in our docs . Holding NEWT means being aligned with the core purpose of Newton Protocol: to bring programmable, verifiable automation onchain. With NEWT, users, developers, and validators will be able to participate in the Newton Protocol ecosystem, whether it’s through securing the protocol, coordinating agent behavior, or governing its evolution. NEWT aligns network participation with protocol integrity—ensuring those who benefit from Newton’s infrastructure are also stewards of its future. Airdrop Eligibility You may be eligible for airdrop if you have participated in one of the four activities listed below: Used Newton.xyz to interact with the protocol before June 12, 2025 at 03:59:59 AM UTC Engaged in community activities through Magic Newton Portal, Guild.xyz and Discord before June 12, 2025 at 03:59:59 AM UTC Participated in Newton's Kaito yappers campaign before June 19 at 11:59:59PM UTC Performed onchain actions with an active, email-linked Magic Labs embedded wallet on Ethereum mainnet or Polygon mainnet with select partners within the 6-month period between July 1, 2024 and December 21, 2024 More details on airdrop eligibility and how to claim and stake NEWT can be found here . To encourage participation and secure the network early, users who stake their claimed NEWT immediately and keep it staked for 30 days will receive a one-time 25% bonus , distributed in August 2025. Bot activity, duplicate accounts, and farming behavior were filtered to ensure fairness. Eligible users will be able to claim and stake their NEWT tokens at newton.xyz . The Newton ecosystem is just getting started. Claim your tokens, stake to secure the network, and help shape the future of onchain automation.
